overview: The display-scoreboard binding is invisible to the corpus. The only hit is Artemis HardcodeMap, which maps PacketPlayOutScoreboardDisplayObjective to the PacketPlayServerScoreboardObjectiveDisplay wrapper for the packet generator (line 59). Shard's monitor does emit and observe the display binding (WrapperPlayServerDisplayScoreboard in ScoreboardPacketBridge and ScoreboardSlotObserver), but those files were mined under the S3C corpus, so they cannot be attributed here. No anticheat validates the slot byte: the packet is client-rendering state with no timing or movement content and no serverbound counterpart.
